description: This file defines and exports functions and types for registering and managing plugins within the OpenClaw framework, including creating plugin registration objects, handling plugin API setup, and registering various plugin components such as providers, CLI commands, and tools.

methods.name: createCapturedPluginRegistration
methods.description: Creates a plugin registration object with default or provided configuration, setting up internal arrays and API handlers for plugin components.

methods.name: capturePluginRegistration
methods.description: Creates a plugin registration object and registers it via a provided registration function.
